test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 7 March 2023)
subject: general
question: Identify the correct statement.

options.text: Newton is a unit of force.
Newton is a unit of power.
Joule is a unit of force.
Joule is a unit of power.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Newton is a unit of force**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Force (F) is defined as the pushing or pulling of an object, due to which the motion of the body will be changed.

 
• Mathematically, a force can be written as:

F = ma

Where m = mass of the body and a = acceleration of the body
